message.content:
The cover of Tempo magazine, dated "19-25 AGUSTUS 2024," features a large, stylized illustration of a man’s face in a deep red and black color palette. The face, shown from a three-quarter angle, fills most of the frame. Shadows define the man’s nose, lips, and eyes, while high-contrast lighting highlights his forehead and cheek. His dark hair is neatly groomed. In the bottom right corner, a semi-transparent group of men in formal attire and traditional headwear are seated in a tiered auditorium, overlapping the lower portion of the central figure's face and shoulder.

Large white block letters at the top center spell "TEMPO." Below this, text reads "EDISI KHUSUS KEMERDEKAAN MOHAMMAD HOESNI THAMRIN" and "ANAK BETAWI PEJUANG REPUBLIK." Additional small white text describes his role in the "Dewan Rakyat." A logo in the upper right displays the number "79" next to the words "NUSANTARA BARU INDONESIA MAJU." The bottom left includes a barcode, a QR code, the price "RP 65.000," and the website "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO." The background is a solid dark red.
